checkpoint.contents: weights only: main_xtal_pw20 epoch 20 (the network and its own direction head) plus dir_ensemble.0-24, the 25 heads of set mask50; per-head training records in the checkpoint's head_records

training.data: train10M_xtal: the train10M pool converted to measured ATAR strip/plane positions and LYSO crystal positions (scratch_pipeline/train10M_xtal)

direction_heads.inputs: train10M_xtal train.parquet chunk 9 (998,699 events after the hit cap), val.parquet row group 0 first 100,000 events, dumped at trigger threshold 0.001
direction_heads.per_head: random init seed 1000+i, random half of the events seed 2000+i, batch order seed 3000+i, pooled hits at trigger probability > 0.5, 60,000 steps of 100 events, AdamW 5e-4 halved three times to 6.25e-5, weight decay 1e-3, clip 2; loss 0.25 x (1 - cos) on match-gated events + 0.05 x moment decorrelation
direction_heads.time: 25 heads trained together in 346 s on the g3200 GPU

evaluation.samples: pie: 39 shards of norad_flat_rs (10,077,230 events); Michel: 392 shards of the open fl2 Michel pool regenerated with its recipe and seeds (101,496,177 events); all converted to measured strip and crystal positions
evaluation.michel_pool: trigger chain not kPienu, kPidif, kMurad or kMudif, and true positron energy <= 52.83 MeV
evaluation.acceptance_bias_definition: counting: truth-accepted (truth_acceptance, t_true <= 495 ns) vs reco-accepted (pred_accepted, t_reco in [-300, 495] ns, |t_reco - t_true| < 5 ns); bias = (1 + NET_pie) / (1 + NET_michel) - 1

acceptance_bias_percent.timing_row_split: wrong positron chosen (accidental) +0.012, right positron mis-timed by 5-30 ns -0.002; the first is identification, the second and the 495 ns window edge come from the counting definition
acceptance_bias_percent.head_recipe_dependence: 25-head averages of other sets: finetune (from the network's own head) angle -0.035, mask10 +0.031; single heads scatter by 0.03-0.07

angle_resolution_near_120_deg.definition: interquartile range / 1.349 of reco - true polar angle, true angle 110-130 deg, claimed events

validation.release_runner_vs_study: release runner with this profile on 3000 events each of Michel shard 000 and pie shard 00: polar angle equals the mean of the 25 mask50 head angles of the study to <= 1.0e-4 deg, acceptance identical (0 mismatches); every other column identical to the same run without heads on the same node
validation.default_path: the plain pw20 checkpoint through the edited model code (PURITY_DIR_HEADS 0) reproduces the study's evaluation: discrete outputs identical, continuous ones within float rounding between node types (<= 3e-6 in positions and directions)
